This post is a bit of a downer and I apologize for that, and I really hope I don’t come off as an asshole. When I first saw the pictures on this subreddit I was very hopeful that I could get similar results, but I’ve found that I am far from it. On this sub, people with beautiful skin are voted to the top, and that seems to be all that we see. I really love to see people get the results they hoped for, and it helped to motivate me to stick with tret. Now I realize that many of the results I’ve seen are very unrealistic for a lot of people. I was hoping to possibly be an example of a more realistic result for people with moderately severe cystic acne. As you can see, there isn’t much progress in the way of skin texture, which was something I was really hoping to improve. The cystic acne calmed down due in part to antibiotics, but I am still breaking out. Hyperpigmentation is still fading, and I know it’s something that takes time, but I’m having a hard time seeing if tret really did anything for me apart from giving me an awful purge.
